title: SliceResponse
description: The slice, base, bugs and interface handed on to the later steps, the files the builder may not change, and the start card the owner reads before anything is cut.

interface.description: The interface files the slice builds against, relative to the project, such as schema files and interface .yaml files fixed before the build. Empty when the slice names none.

fixed.description: The files the builder may not change: every test file the slice's fails-first items name. Empty when the builder writes its own tests.

card.description: The start card: the slice's title, kind, base, scope and afters, every item of its definition of done, and the bugs: those named to inject, whether the planter writes them, or that none will be planted.

lines.description: One line for each thing the card says, wrapped by the kernel to 44 columns. A word longer than 40 characters is broken after a slash, or else where it must. A long card has as many lines as it needs and is never cut.

mark.description: Every line of the start card comes from a step that ran no skill.

words.description: What the owner reads, worked out by script from the slice and proof's answer, never a builder's words.
